create a similiar script for this person: Allan Khoshbin 

Marketing Director

Global Sales, Inc. Aniise Natural Skin Care and Cosmetics


Los Angeles, California, United States Welcome to the wonderful world of Aniise!
We are a unique provider of natural beauty supply, healthy skincare products, cosmetics, and body care company that have built our foundation on the premise of “Inner Confidence, Outer Glow”.
We formulate and develop products that are made from essential oils, herbs, botanicals and natural vitamins that protect and build healthy skin cells. All of our products are cruelty-free and manufactured in our laboratories in the United States.

The Aniise Difference
At Aniise, we refrain from using alcohol, acids, parabens and other harmful ingredients that over time will dry and damage the skin by removing its outer layer, leaving it vulnerable to outside elements, such as the sun and the cold. We believe in no non-sense, no gimmick products that actually thicken the skin to prevent, protect and enhance the feel and look of it. The result is moisturized, smooth, supple and glowing skin. Our line of products are like health food for your skin….the more you use them, the better your skin will get. Our natural beauty supply and healthy skincare products are unisex and can be used by anyone at any age.

We are primarily a skin care company that expanded into cosmetics. As such, our make-up is also mineral and actually beneficial to the skin. Our products feel light on the skin, yet provide great coverage without clogging the pores and causing breakouts. Every time, you use any of our cosmetics, you are enhancing not only your beauty, but the health of your skin.

On a Personal Note
Like many teenagers and adolescents, I struggled with skin problems growing up…… more specifically acne. As I grew older, like many, I tackled the issue of wrinkles and look young. I am sure you can relate.

I tried many different products in the market, from drugstore brands to higher- end ones and even prescription drugs. They would seem to improve the skin temporarily, however, after 3 or 4 months of use, my skin would begin to feel dry, tired and lifeless.
There had to be better solutions out there. Thus, I began researching and the deeper I dug, the more it was certain that my skin issues were a common side effect of acids and chemicals. I am not the only one. Many others to whom I spoke had the same skin problems and complaints. Finally, my sister and I began to explore the natural options, which we are happy to say did work.

And……this is how Aniise was born.

We would like to thank you for visiting our website and hope you find our products appealing. We can always be reached by phone @ 310.474.7700 or via email at cs@aniise.com

Stay Beautiful,

Sheida

## 🎙️ Podcast Script  
**Guest:** Mitch Leff, Chief Operating Officer (“Chief Motivator”)

---

### 🎧 INTRO

Hi everyone, and welcome back to *The Aesthetic Edge* — the podcast where we dive deep with the visionaries, operators, and aesthetic experts who are redefining what’s possible in this industry. I’m your host, Bethany Gifford — founder of New Era Intel and your guide to all things growth, systems, and modern medspa leadership.

**BUT FIRST, A WORD FROM OUR SPONSOR:**  
[Insert sponsor message or placeholder]

Today’s guest is someone who proves that operations *are* culture — and that leadership doesn’t always wear a white coat.

I’m joined by **Mitch Leff**, Chief Operating Officer — or as he’s better known internally — **Chief Motivator** of **Neinstein Plastic Surgery**, a world-renowned, breast-and-body-only surgical practice based in the heart of New York City.

With nearly 50 team members across two high-performing facilities, Neinstein has become a destination for elite-level cosmetic care — thanks in no small part to Mitch’s relentless focus on culture, systems, and what he calls “the best medical experience a patient could ever have anywhere in the world.”

From vendor relationships and HR to patient logistics and post-op hugs, Mitch touches nearly every part of the non-medical operation. His leadership style? All in — and always focused on joy, service, and results.

Mitch, welcome to *The Aesthetic Edge!*

---

### 🧠 SEGMENT 1: Leadership & Culture

**Bethany:**  
Let’s start with this title you’ve earned — *Chief Motivator.* What does that mean to you day-to-day?

**Bethany:**  
What have been the key pillars in building the culture you have now — one that combines both high standards and humility?

**Bethany:**  
You and Dr. Neinstein are both extremely hands-on leaders. How does that impact staff morale and, ultimately, the patient experience?

---

### ⚙️ SEGMENT 2: Operational Excellence & Scaling

**Bethany:**  
You’re running a team of nearly 50 across two buildings. What are the operational systems or rhythms that keep things flowing smoothly?

**Bethany:**  
I’ve heard you mention “team silos” in a positive way — can you explain how this structure works for you?

**Bethany:**  
What are some of the unique challenges that come with running a high-volume, hyper-specialized surgical practice?

---

### 💡 SEGMENT 3: The Patient Experience

**Bethany:**  
Can you walk us through what a typical patient journey looks like — from initial inquiry all the way to their one-year post-op?

**Bethany:**  
Scaling often means losing touch — but your reviews say the opposite. How do you keep that five-star experience consistent?

**Bethany:**  
How do you collect and act on patient feedback to keep improving?

---

### 🧬 SEGMENT 4: Specialization & Strategy

**Bethany:**  
What led the team to focus exclusively on breast and body — and how has that helped shape the brand?

**Bethany:**  
Has that specialization changed your referral relationships or reputation in the market?

**Bethany:**  
Do you think hyper-specialization is the future of aesthetic medicine?

---

### 📈 SEGMENT 5: Marketing, Retention & KPIs

**Bethany:**  
Let’s talk growth — what are some of your most effective marketing channels right now?

**Bethany:**  
How do you keep brand messaging consistent across the entire patient journey — from Instagram to intake?

**Bethany:**  
What systems or tools are you using to handle lead gen, follow-up, and booking?

**Bethany:**  
What role does word-of-mouth or influencer marketing play in your strategy?

**Bethany:**  
Patient retention is tricky in a surgery-first business. How are you keeping patients connected to the brand long after the OR?

**Bethany:**  
Are there any KPIs you track weekly or monthly to keep a pulse on business health?

**Bethany:**  
Looking 6–12 months out — what’s next for Neinstein, and what’s one thing that would make that vision easier to achieve?

---

### 🎯 SEGMENT 6: Advice for Operators

**Bethany:**  
For other COOs or operations leaders — what’s one shift you made that truly moved the needle?

**Bethany:**  
What advice would you give to someone operating a small practice and looking to grow sustainably?

---

### 📢 OUTRO

**Bethany:**  
Mitch, this was so packed with value — from mindset to operations to leadership strategy. Thank you for showing us what it looks like to build a truly human-centered, high-performance aesthetic business.

For listeners who want to learn more about Neinstein Plastic Surgery, or even connect with you personally — where’s the best place to find you?

**[Mitch plugs IG/website/contact info]**

To our listeners — if you loved this episode, don’t forget to subscribe, leave a review, and share with a friend in the industry who needs to hear this.

Until next time — stay sharp, stay curious, and keep raising the bar.
